lead: Glass terrarium measuring 80x50x60 cm. Volume: 240.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 80x50x60 cm terrarium has 240 liters and a floor of 4000 cm². The 60 cm height is 10 cm more than on the 80x50x50 model. Use that space for deeper substrate, a taller branch or a shelf. It comes without a 3D background, with film on the outer sides.

Kingsnakes are active and climb, so 60 cm of height with branches gives them more space than the floor alone. A medium-sized adult ball python has the width for a large hide. For tortoises and a skink the substrate layer can be 10 to 15 cm deep while the lamp stays at a good distance. A young bearded dragon can live here until it is fully grown, while an adult needs a length of 100 cm.

Anyone who wants the same floor with less height takes the 80x50x50. For permanent housing of an adult bearded dragon we recommend the 100x50x50. We build a terrarium to your dimensions in 7 to 14 days and ship it by courier. You choose the film pattern for the back and sides from the 34 on offer.
